## The five heroes (bosses; you play one of them)

### BigWman (`bigwman`)
- Team: bat, banshee, ghost

- After losing: "I need to update the spreadsheet. YES… no."
- Epitaph: "Balanced the budget. Not the life."
- Map position now: [9,44]
- Opening line to each other hero:

  - to loken: "I respect the lawn, Löken. I don't respect the lawn budget."
  - to ljunky: "Bitcoin is not an asset class. It's a cry for help."

### Wizcudi (`wizcudi`)

### Ljunky (`ljunky`)
